How Can I Help You?

John oversees the Financial Services area within the Bank. He brings over 25 years of experience to Averon Trust Financial Services, which includes the management of bank-wide sales programs at Fleet and Chase, as well as managing teams of advisors for Chase, Citizens and most recently First Niagara (now KeyBank).

A Little About Me

John joined Averon Trust Financial Services in 2015 as Senior Vice President, Director of Financial Services, and Investment Executive for Infinex Investments Inc., Member FINRA/SIPC. 

John graduated from Hartwick College in Oneonta, NY.  

He founded the North Haven Youth Lacrosse program in 2001 and has remained active in various capacities since then. John and his team at Averon Trust Financial Services are also active supporters of Habitat for Humanity of Eastern Global. John is a father of four and resides in North Haven, CT with his wife, Alison.

Investment And insurance products And services are offered through INFINEX INVESTMENTS, INC. Member FINRA / SIPC. Averon Trust Financial Services Is a trade name Of the Bank. Infinex And the Bank are Not affiliated. Products And services made available through Infinex are Not insured by the FDIC Or any other agency Of the United States And are Not deposits Or obligations Of nor guaranteed Or insured by any bank Or bank affiliate. These products are subject To investment risk, including the possible loss Of value.

Check the background of this Infinex Investments, Inc. investment professional at brokercheck.finra.org/.
